text:
**My pick: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 with two 200W solar panels.** It’s a close match to 2,000 Wh, with **2,073.6 Wh** of LiFePO₄ capacity, a **2,600W** inverter, and **400W of included panels**. The listing says the two-panel kit is **$1,499** and estimates a **1–1.5 sunny-day** recharge. [See the kit and price](https://dealectric.com/best-2000wh-solar-generator-kit-with-panels).

If you want to spend less, the same guide lists a one-panel 200W version at **$1,199**—but estimates **2–3 sunny days** to recharge. [See that option](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit).

A good alternative is the [Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 with two 200W panels](https://generatorandbackup.com/power-stations/best-solar-generators-home-backup), listed at **2,042 Wh** and **2,200W** output.
